meta_description: B Purnell Electrical Contractors in Bristol. NICEIC registered electrician offering rewires, PAT testing, fault finding and emergency callouts. Call 07731 525589.
hero_subhead: Blown fuse at 11pm? Circuit breaker tripping? We're on call across Bristol. Same-day repairs, no weekend surcharge.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and fault diagnosis to full rewires and safety inspections — we handle every electrical need.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped circuits, and power cuts fixed fast. We arrive quickly and diagnose the fault on the spot — most repairs completed same day.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Upgrade ageing wiring safely and boost your home's electrical capacity. NICEIC certified work comes with a 10-year guarantee and peace of mind.

services.title: PAT Testing & Inspections
services.desc: Portable appliance testing for businesses and landlords. We issue full compliance certificates and flag any safety concerns before they become problems.

services.title: Fault Finding & Diagnosis
services.desc: Intermittent tripping, burning smells, or flickering lights? We trace the root cause using professional testing equipment and fix it properly.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boxes are dangerous and limiting. We install modern, safer consumer units that protect your wiring and handle today's demand for power.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: EICR reports and electrical safety certificates for letting properties. We meet legal requirements and ensure your tenants are protected.

about_pullquote: I started this business on honesty — no hidden charges, no unnecessary work, just solid electrical expertise.
about_para_1: B Purnell Electrical Contractors has been serving Bristol homes and businesses for over 18 years. We're NICEIC registered and proud to carry out work to the highest safety standards. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local firm — built on word-of-mouth and repeat customers who know we turn up when we say we will.
about_para_2: We don't upsell or complicate things. If your circuit breaker's tripping, we find out why and fix it. If you need a full rewire, we explain exactly what's involved and give you a clear price upfront. That straightforward approach is why 9 out of 10 customers call us back for their next job.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had an electrical fault that was making a burning smell. B Purnell came out within the hour, found the problem immediately, and sorted it that same day. Very professional, fair price, and didn't try to sell me unnecessary work. Definitely using them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed a full rewire on a 1960s terrace. From start to finish, B Purnell was brilliant. Explained everything clearly, minimal disruption, and the work quality is spot on. They even fixed a couple of dodgy outlets we weren't expecting. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: Called them at 10pm on a Saturday when our kitchen lights went out. They answered, came within the hour, and had us back on before midnight. No weekend premium, just a straightforward repair. That's the kind of service you remember.
reviews.author: James P.
